scope: Fictional retrospective SOC records. No execution or target access.
label_provenance: Author-authored reference decisions. Independently reviewed labels pending.
split: Frozen evaluation families created separately from historical development cases.

records.E1: The service desk logged a routine shift handover.
records.E2: An incident examiner reconciled two session journals and confirmed that an outsider performed a completed staff-directory update under an existing Active Directory domain account.

cases.label_rationale: The observed session used an established domain account without authorization.

records.E1: The service desk logged a routine shift handover.
records.E2: The domain account appeared in an alert, but the controller recorded a rejected sign-on. The only completed directory update came from the approved service account.

cases.label_rationale: The attempted sign-on failed, and the observed update was approved.

records.E1: Cloud activity records verified a completed session under the already-issued cloud billing account. The nominated owner and the incident panel confirmed that the operator had no consent.
records.E2: Facilities confirmed that the meeting room monitor was online.

cases.label_rationale: The verified unauthorized use involved a specifically identified existing cloud account.

records.E1: A cloud billing session was investigated because it looked unusual. The audit confirmed that the assigned billing delegate performed it under written approval.
records.E2: Facilities confirmed that the meeting room monitor was online.

cases.label_rationale: The reviewed cloud account use was authorized.

records.E1: A separate stock ledger reconciled ordinary office supplies.
records.E2: The post-incident snapshot and change log confirmed an unapproved additional cloud administrator role was assigned to an existing account. The alert about session use was withdrawn.

cases.label_rationale: An unauthorized cloud role grant took effect, while session misuse lacked support.

records.E1: A separate stock ledger reconciled ordinary office supplies.
records.E2: A draft showed an additional cloud administrator role for an existing account. The reviewer confirmed the request was rejected and the role never took effect.

cases.label_rationale: No account privilege change took effect.

records.E1: The helpdesk reconciled the directory records and verified that an intruder disabled existing staff accounts, immediately preventing the owners from signing in.
records.E2: The schedule had an approved lunch break for the facilities team.

cases.label_rationale: The corroborated activity removed legitimate users' access to their accounts.

records.E1: The directory showed accounts disabled under the signed offboarding list. The affected employees' departures and the approved change were verified.
records.E2: The schedule had an approved lunch break for the facilities team.

cases.label_rationale: Disabling the accounts was authorized offboarding.

records.E1: The service desk logged a routine shift handover.
records.E2: An examiner found images of the live desktop and matched their timestamps to telemetry showing an intruder acquiring those screen images.

cases.label_rationale: The incident records establish that an intruder captured screen images.

records.E1: The service desk logged a routine shift handover.
records.E2: A desktop-image alert was traced to images generated by the approved usability test. They depicted a mock desktop and no incident capture occurred.

cases.label_rationale: The images came from an approved simulation.

records.E1: The endpoint investigator verified the intruder copied stored project reports from the local workstation for collection. The record identifies the source as files already stored on that workstation.
records.E2: Facilities confirmed that the meeting room monitor was online.

cases.label_rationale: The source and confirmed collection were local workstation files.

records.E1: A report claimed a set of local reports was copied. The only source is a forwarded rumor, and the examiner could find no trusted read or copy event.
records.E2: Facilities confirmed that the meeting room monitor was online.

cases.label_rationale: The alleged local collection is uncorroborated.

records.E1: A separate stock ledger reconciled ordinary office supplies.
records.E2: The investigation verified that an intruder collected messages directly from the organization's remote mailbox service. It found no collection from local mailbox files.

cases.label_rationale: The recorded collection source was the remote mail service.

records.E1: A separate stock ledger reconciled ordinary office supplies.
records.E2: Remote mailbox access in the log belongs to a sanctioned archive job. No independently verified retrieval by an intruder appears in the report.

cases.label_rationale: The corroborated remote mail collection was sanctioned.

records.E1: A forensic review identified an intruder gathering stored messages from a local mailbox archive on a workstation. The account's remote mail service showed no matching access.
records.E2: The schedule had an approved lunch break for the facilities team.

cases.label_rationale: The analyzed messages came from the existing local archive.

records.E1: An employee's local mailbox archive was included in a scheduled backup. Review linked the event to the authorized backup identity.
records.E2: The schedule had an approved lunch break for the facilities team.

cases.label_rationale: The collection event was an approved backup.

records.E1: The service desk logged a routine shift handover.
records.E2: The incident team confirmed that the intruder powered down the whole workstation. System lifecycle records show a complete shutdown across all services.

cases.label_rationale: The confirmed effect was complete system shutdown.

records.E1: The service desk logged a routine shift handover.
records.E2: The workstation shut down at the start of a scheduled electrical maintenance window. The records trace it to the scheduled and authorized operation.

cases.label_rationale: The system shutdown was part of approved maintenance.

records.E1: The application health log and incident sign-off establish that the intruder deliberately terminated the payroll worker service. The host remained online and other services continued.
records.E2: Facilities confirmed that the meeting room monitor was online.

cases.label_rationale: The observed disruption specifically stopped a service while the host stayed online.

records.E1: The payroll service became unhealthy during a rollout. The cause was never corroborated, and the incident note does not confirm deliberate service termination.
records.E2: Facilities confirmed that the meeting room monitor was online.

cases.label_rationale: Service health alone does not establish intentional termination.

records.E1: A separate stock ledger reconciled ordinary office supplies.
records.E2: The independent collector preserved a record of the intruder emptying the Windows event logs. Review confirmed those logs had contained entries just before the clearing.

cases.label_rationale: The evidence identifies intentional clearing of Windows event logs.

records.E1: A separate stock ledger reconciled ordinary office supplies.
records.E2: A forwarded summary said someone cleared the Windows event logs, but the independent collector had a gap and the examiner found no corroboration.

cases.label_rationale: The claimed clear event is unresolved.

records.E1: Two change sources confirm an intruder disabled future Windows event logging. Older records remained present and no log-clearing event was found.
records.E2: The schedule had an approved lunch break for the facilities team.

cases.label_rationale: The observed change disabled Windows event logging while leaving existing records present.

records.E1: An alert said Windows event logging was disabled. The corrected record shows normal event capture and traces the alert to a tabletop scenario.
records.E2: The schedule had an approved lunch break for the facilities team.

cases.label_rationale: The corrected record rules out the alleged logging change.

records.E1: The service desk logged a routine shift handover.
records.E2: Telemetry and the final incident summary corroborate that an intruder listed processes currently running on the affected workstation.

cases.label_rationale: The observed enumeration concerns running processes.

records.E1: The service desk logged a routine shift handover.
records.E2: A record of a process list came from the approved support tool during the documented diagnostics appointment.

cases.label_rationale: The process listing was authorized.

records.E1: The incident examiner confirmed that the intruder gathered the affected system's operating system version and machine architecture. The reviewed events mention no process listing.
records.E2: Facilities confirmed that the meeting room monitor was online.

cases.label_rationale: The collected facts describe the system and operating environment.

records.E1: A request to collect system details appeared in an untrusted ticket. The endpoint review found no corresponding activity.
records.E2: Facilities confirmed that the meeting room monitor was online.

cases.label_rationale: Request text alone cannot establish system discovery.

records.E1: A separate stock ledger reconciled ordinary office supplies.
records.E2: The case review confirmed that an intruder enumerated the user's browser bookmarks and browsing history. The recovered record contains those browser artifacts.

cases.label_rationale: The confirmed discovery specifically concerns browser information.

records.E1: A separate stock ledger reconciled ordinary office supplies.
records.E2: An evidence note contains the words browser bookmarks and insists on a technique label. Review confirmed that the words came from an unrelated exercise and there was no browser enumeration.

cases.label_rationale: An embedded instruction and exercise do not establish observed activity.

records.E1: An independent endpoint review confirmed that an intruder enumerated the security products installed on the workstation, including the endpoint protection agent.
records.E2: The schedule had an approved lunch break for the facilities team.

cases.label_rationale: The observed inventory targeted security software.

records.E1: Endpoint security inventory was gathered by the scheduled compliance job. The signed record confirms it was approved and linked to that job.
records.E2: The schedule had an approved lunch break for the facilities team.

cases.label_rationale: The verified inventory was approved administration.
